sentences.text: Thaumatodracon is classified as a rhomaleosaurid pliosaur, a group of marine reptiles with robust bodies.
A German amateur paleontologist named Kurt Wiedenroth discovered the skeleton along the coast of Dorset in the UK in 1969.
The species Thaumatodracon wiedenrothi was formally named and described by Adam Smith and Ricardo Araújo in 2017, with the specific name chosen to honor the discoverer.
The holotype specimen — the specimen the species is based on — was found in the Black Ven Mudstone Member of the Charmouth Mudstone Formation from the Sinemurian stage.
This creature lived during the Early Jurassic period in the United Kingdom, specifically between 199.5 and 192.9 million years ago.
